title: Separate rate-limit and quota attribution for mixed KV/prefetch cache slices
creator: Maya Chen
description: Problem: Mixed response paths (prefix prefetch + KV cache hits + compute tokens) are currently causing inaccurate token/quota and rate-limit charging. When a batch contains requests that partially hit prefix/KV cache and partially require compute, the metering pipeline attributes full token costs to all requests in the coalesced batch in the pre-aggregation step. This results in inflated quota consumption, spurious rate-limit breaches, and customer complaints for workloads with bursty prefix patterns. Goal: ensure per-request quotas and rate-limit reservations reflect the actual compute work consumed while preserving low-latency bookkeeping and compatibility with existing billing records. We must avoid retrospective customer-facing charge reversals; prefer conservative upfront reservations + asynchronous reconciliation to correct over/under-charges.
comments: 2025-02-13 - Diego A.: Initial triage: reproduced on staging with mixed-batch replay; attached flamegraph and token-attribution traces.
2025-02-15 - Maya C.: Proposal v0: reserve based on worst-case token counts per-route, then issue a reconciliation delta on finalization. Concern: could penalize low-tier customers during spikes.

2025-02-18 - Priya S. (Billing): If we do asynchronous reconciliation, finance wants a 48h window before making any outward-facing invoice changes; customers should see provisional usage and then final adjustments.

2025-02-20 - Diego A.: Spike experiment: implemented a cheap shim in the metering step that marks KV-hit requests with cache_token_count and compute_token_count. Observed a 23% reduction in misattributed tokens in the sample workload.
2025-02-24 - Alex R. (SRE): Runtime concern: the reconciliation requires write traffic to the metering DB; we need to shard reconciliation workers to avoid hot partitions. Planned a canary lane.
2025-02-26 - Product review: PM requested a UX signal in Console showing provisional vs finalized charges per-route to reduce support noise.

2025-02-28 - Diego A.: Open PR: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4127 (metering: per-request compute attribution + delta reconciler). Unit tests added for prefix-only, full-compute, and mixed batches.

2025-03-01 - Maya C.: Rolling plan approved: canary reconcile on 10% of traffic for 72h, observe delta distribution, then 50% for 48h before full rollout. Add billing safety caps: if delta > 25% for a customer, hold further automated invoices and open alert for manual review.
acceptance_criteria: Per-request final invoiceable token count equals compute_token_count + configured cache_charge for KV hits (default zero) for 99.9% of requests in canary cohort
Console shows provisional vs finalized usage and provides links to request-level reconciliation logs
No >2x spike in metering DB write QPS during canary; reconciliation workers autoscale to keep p99 reconciliation latency < 5s
Regression tests cover partial KV hits, interleaved batch merges, and multi-tenant burst scenarios
rollout_plan: Step 1 (canary): enable compute-token attribution and async reconciler on 10% of traffic for 72h
Step 2 (observe): monitor delta histogram, cost impact, support tickets, and reconciliation latency
Step 3 (expand): ramp to 50% for 48h; enable console provisional charges view for canary customers
Step 4 (full): 100% rollout with automatic invoice adjustments subject to finance safety caps
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: reconciliation lag creates temporary over-reservation causing customer throttles. Mitigation: conservative upfront reservation algorithm (min(worst-case, historical p95)) and user-facing provisional allowances.
Risk: increased metering DB load. Mitigation: shard reconciliation keys, sample heavy customers for synchronous processing, and add backpressure into reconciler queue.

Risk: edge-case models with variable per-token compute cost (sparse attention). Mitigation: add model-profiled compute coefficients into attribution pipeline; fallback to conservative estimate if profile missing.
